title: Silicon-strip detector analysis
data_origin: laboratory measurement exports and a documented notebook transcription

instrument_context.source: Laboratory manual and report; per-run settings unavailable

scope: Aggregate results, analysis code and metadata

index_conventions.channel_index: zero-based matrix column or row index
index_conventions.channel_label: historical filename label, not assumed identical to channel_index convention
index_conventions.source_line: one-based physical line of the selected input
index_conventions.source_column: one-based physical column of the selected input
index_conventions.export_bin_center: original floating-point histogram coordinate, not silently converted to an event or channel ID

method_status.energy_spectrum: optional scientific validation outside current ADC-level curation scope
method_status.laser_cce_fit: optional extension outside current project scope
method_status.common_mode_corrected_noise: recomputed from selected event matrix; separate from historical noise export

reported_bias_caveat: 100 V stated in updated report, not verified in per-file acquisition records
data_profile: Aggregate statistics from selected event and cluster excerpts
